messages.subject: Asynchronous shiny process
parts:
I have a shiny app, oiModel,  that analyzes some stock option data.  The data it uses is available daily just after 9AM.  So I want to run a separate shiny process that wakes up every day at roughly 9:05, reads the data (from finance.yahoo.com) and then saves it to a file.  This file is then used by oiModel whenever the shiny app is run.

So I thought the way to do it would be to have a second shiny app, say updateOptionData that would run asynchronously.     something like this: for the server. 
(basically just an endless while loop which executes code then pauses for a day)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
aDayInSec <- 60*60*24
while (T) {
        theTime <- as.POSIXlt(Sys.time(), "EST")
    cat("addSnapShot on:", theTime$mday, "th  at" ,theTime$hour,":", theTime$min,"\n")
    self <- Retained$new(reset=F)
    self$addASnapShot()
        self$saveSS()
        Sys.sleep(aDayInSec)
}
 )
